description: Hlavní odvodňovací a závlahová zařízení is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstvo zemědělství. This dataset is a registry of major drainage and irrigation facilities owned by the state. Water bodies for the water melioration of agricultural land shall be recorded to the extent of the data on their territorial identification and the data stipulated in the Decree on water administration registry. Coverage: Ministerstvo zemědělství. The portal shows the English title as "Main drainage and irrigation facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstvo zemědělství. Its keywords include závlahová zařízení, irrigation facilities, vodoprávní evidence, water administration registry, odvodňovací zařízení, drainage facilities. The listing shows 1 download or service links in SHP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/00020478/cb778e63831a70a31eebb0f9fb7fca41/distribuce/bf6f3ef02cc2b65477f31ae7bbe20da0/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
